model.statement: On this M6 in the Release build, 32 environments increase aggregate accepted environment steps per wall second by 1000 to 1000000 compared with one environment for 100 host-sinusoidal control steps.

reason: All ten paired trials passed declared accounting checks; observed mean difference lies in the broad registered interval.
next_test: Qualify force and motion for a fixed physical workload, then compare accepted simulated time at matched error using an independently specified reference and new fixed seeds.
limitations: Single M6, host-sinusoidal actions with no rendering, learning, continuum, physical accuracy or comparator; thermal and background macOS activity uncontrolled. Host action generation excluded from timed interval.
